recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as an external-repo decision. Follow up in the FHIR Extension Pack to decide whether the encounter-reasonCancelled description and differential definition should change to the softer FHIR-39363 wording, considering that FHIR-52945 later replaced the original appointment cancellation binding target with a dedicated encounter cancellation value set.
issue_request: FHIR-39363 was a Published FHIR-core Patient Administration issue for the Encounter reasonCancelled extension. Its Persuasive with Modification resolution requested an example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/appointment-cancellation-reason and, instead of adding an invariant, changing the documentation sentence from "Applies only if the status is cancelled." to "Usually applies when the status is cancelled.".
initial_application: Core commit c4d724de25bab25db907de4320824cd216c67935 added the appointment-cancellation-reason example binding to source/encounter/structuredefinition-extension-encounter-reasonCancelled.xml. The same historical file still retained the old "Applies only if the status is cancelled." description/definition wording.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed the Encounter extension definitions from the R5 core source and removed their Encounter-core IG resource references. Current core searches find encounter-reasonCancelled only in source/oids.ini, while the active StructureDefinition is in the FHIR Extension Pack. Later Published FHIR-extensions issue FHIR-52945 created a dedicated encounter-reasonCancelled example value set now used by the Extension Pack definition.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The remaining wording reconciliation, if pursued, belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack file input/definitions/Encounter/StructureDefinition-encounter-reasonCancelled.xml rather than in HL7/fhir core.
